# 行舟 · 个人项目与事务中心 v0.5.0

这是一次数据架构升级。行舟现在独立保存和维护完整工作项，不再要求用额外的思源数据库或文档承载核心数据；同时新增跨领域、跨顶层项目的前置关系。

## 主要更新

- 完整保存名称、类型、状态、行动内容、日期、时长、精力、层级、文档关联和跨项目依赖。
- 从 v0.4.x 升级时，一次性导入旧属性视图和旧版插件依赖数据；迁移完成后不再读取或修改旧数据库。
- 每次修改前轮换保存三个内部历史版本，写入后重新读取并比对；主数据损坏时优先从最新有效备份恢复。
- 新增“完成后开始”和“需先行”两种跨项目依赖，可连接任意领域中的工作项。
- 阻止自依赖、重复依赖和循环依赖，并显示反向引用与尚未完成的硬依赖。
- 删除工作项时保留下级工作项，并自动清除其他工作项对它的层级和依赖引用。

## 升级说明

首次打开 v0.5.0 时，行舟会自动迁移旧数据并创建内部迁移快照。确认工作项正常显示后，即使删除旧数据库或承载数据库的文档，行舟内部工作项仍会保留。被删除的关联思源文档本身仍无法再打开。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.5.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Projects & Tasks v0.5.0

This release upgrades Xingzhou's data architecture. Complete work items are now owned and maintained by the plugin without requiring an extra SiYuan database or document, and prerequisites can cross areas and top-level projects.

## Highlights

- Stores titles, roles, statuses, action details, dates, duration, energy, hierarchy, document links, and cross-project dependencies internally.
- Imports the legacy Attribute View and legacy plugin dependency data once when upgrading from v0.4.x, then stops reading or modifying the old database.
- Rotates three internal history files before mutations, verifies every write by reading it back, and recovers a corrupt primary store from the newest valid backup.
- Adds hard “start after completion” and soft “should stay ahead” prerequisites between any work items.
- Prevents self, duplicate, and cyclic dependencies while showing reverse references and unfinished hard prerequisites.
- Keeps descendants when deleting an item and clears hierarchy and dependency references to the removed item.

## Upgrade notes

On the first v0.5.0 launch, Xingzhou migrates legacy data and creates a private migration snapshot. After verifying the migrated items, deleting the legacy database or its containing document does not remove Xingzhou's internal work items. A deleted linked SiYuan document itself can no longer be opened.

## Download

Download the attached `package.zip`. Do not use GitHub's automatically generated source-code archives as the SiYuan plugin package.

See [CHANGELOG.en.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.5.0/CHANGELOG.en.md) for the complete record.
